label: AC-12(1)
title: User-initiated Logouts

statement.prose: Provide a logout capability for user-initiated communications sessions whenever authentication is used to gain access to {{ insert: param, ac-12.01_odp }}.

guidance: Information resources to which users gain access via authentication include local workstations, databases, and password-protected websites or web-based services.

params.label: information resources
guidelines: information resources for which a logout capability for user-initiated communications sessions is required are defined;
